div.p: By signing this agreement, you agree to act as a Professional ("Expert") on the NETTRADES.AI platform. You will be listed in the "Ask Someone" matching pool for the professional fields in which you have been verified.

You agree to provide accurate, professional, and timely responses to requests for expert help. Your answers may be rated by the requester and by other qualified professionals. Consistently low ratings may result in your removal from the platform.
All communications between you and the requester are private. You must not share, reproduce, or disclose any information from a session without the requester's explicit consent.
div.h3: 4. Use of Your Answers for AI Training
div.p: For professional fields where the NETTRADES administrator has enabled the "Use Expert Answers for Training" option, your responses to "Ask Someone" sessions may be used to improve the AI through fine-tuning. The requester's original question is NEVER stored – only the medical, legal, or technical knowledge contained in your answer is used. This helps the AI learn to provide better answers to future users without compromising patient or client confidentiality.
If you do not wish your answers to be used for AI training, you may opt out by not accepting this agreement. However, this will prevent you from being listed as an Expert on the platform.

You agree to indemnify NETTRADES against any claims arising from your provision of expert services.

You will be compensated at your configured hourly rate for each completed session. NETTRADES deducts a platform fee as configured in the platform settings. Payouts are processed according to the schedule defined in your account settings.
